Ask {names}.} resend {Resending needs {permission}. Ask {names}.} edit {Editing needs {permission}. Ask {names}.} other {Publishing needs {permission}. Ask {names}.}}
denied.ask.note: names: members who can help, as 'A or B'

denied.editor: You can open every tab and render with test data. Editing needs {permission}.
denied.editorAsk: You can open every tab and render with test data. Editing needs {permission}. Ask {names}.
denied.publishSaved: Publishing needs {permission}. Your draft is saved.
denied.publishSavedAsk: Publishing needs {permission}. Ask {names}. Your draft is saved.

readOnly.templates.message: You can view templates, test renders, the log and reports. Editing needs transactional:edit and publishing needs transactional:publish. Ask {names}.
readOnly.templates.note: a viewer's note on Transactional › Templates; names: members who can publish

readOnly.templatesNoNames: You can view templates, test renders, the log and reports. Editing needs transactional:edit and publishing needs transactional:publish.
category.descriptionRequired: Optional categories need a description: recipients read it in the preference center.
category.nameTaken: There is already a category called “{name}”.
category.kindFixed: {name} has {count, plural, one {# template} other {# templates}}, so its kind can't change. Move them to another category first.
category.hasTemplates: {name} still has {count, plural, one {# template} other {# templates}}. Move them to another category before deleting it.
replyTo.invalid: The reply-to isn't a valid email address.
sender.pick: Pick a sender from the list.
sender.gone: That sender doesn't exist in this workspace.

sender.notTransactional.message: {email} isn't on a Transactional domain. Pick a sender on one, such as notify.acme.io, in Settings › Senders.

sender.notTransactionalShort.message: {email} isn't on a Transactional domain. Pick a sender on one in Settings › Senders.

template.keyRequired: Give the template an ID, such as password-reset.
template.keyFormat: The ID can use lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, such as password-reset.
template.keyLooksLikeId: The ID can't look like a message ID; use words, such as password-reset.
template.keyTaken: Another template already uses the ID {key}.
template.keyFixed: The ID {key} is fixed: it was published and your app calls it. Duplicate the template to use another ID.
template.categoryPick: Pick a category from the list.
template.categoryGone: That category doesn't exist in this workspace.
template.testDataTwice: There are two test data sets called “{name}”.
template.subjectOneLine: The subject must be one line.

template.someone.note: who saved a draft, when their name isn't known

template.draftConflict.message: {who} saved this draft at {time} while you were editing.

template.deleteLive: {key} is live: your app may still call it. Archive it first; archived templates answer template_not_found.
log.startDate: Pick a start date, such as 2026-10-01.
log.endDate: Pick an end date, such as 2026-10-15.
log.endBeforeStart: The end date is before the start date.

log.tooOld.message: Messages are kept {days} days; pick a date after {date}.

log.status: Pick a status from the list.
log.pageStale: That page link is out of date; reload the log.
log.cursorStale: That cursor is out of date; reload the log.

message.notFound.message: There is no message {id} in this workspace. It may be older than {days} days.
message.notFound.note: id: a message ID as the link has it

content.notKept: This message's content wasn't kept: content retention is 0 days, or the message was stopped before it was rendered for sending.

content.removed.message: The rendered content was removed on {date}, as the content retention says. The summary and events stay until {until}.

resend.sensitive.message: {names} {count, plural, one {is} other {are}} sensitive and wasn't stored, so this message can't be sent again from here. Your app can send a new one.
resend.sensitive.note: names: variable names such as reset_url

resend.attachments: Attachments aren't stored, so this message can't be sent again from here. Your app can send it again.
resend.raw: Mail that arrived by SMTP was rendered by your app, so it can only be sent again from there.
resend.template: {key} has no published version any more, so there is nothing to send.
